notes.title: Furry Adventure Club and the Holy Grail🦁 v0.96 RELEASE!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068842/b812fc44703b36a4cc67781c0706a25e20aebcc5.png
Hello, adventurers and myth enthusiasts!

We’re thrilled to bring you v0.96, one of our biggest updates yet! This time, we’re taking you deep into the Ancient Temple in the Rock, a mysterious and treasure-filled location where your choices will shape your destiny.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3057290/Furry_Adventure_Club_and_the_Holy_Grail/

🔥 What’s New in v0.96? 🔥
🗿 New Location – Explore the Ancient Temple in the Rock, a mysterious site filled with countless secrets and treasures.
📖 New Stages – Continue the story with engaging stages that offer multiple choices leading to diverse outcomes.
❤️ New Date – Enjoy a date with one of our characters.
⚔️ New Raid Mode – Quickly earn the necessary currency by diving into this action-packed mode.
💎 New Currency – Gems – Earn Gems in Raid mode. Use them to sell profitably on the marketplace or to unlock new locations and date options.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068842/42e9da26617681ca780008caf7a0ab6dfa350d9f.jpg

I want to sincerely thank everyone for your feedback and the time you spend playing Furry Adventure Club. Your support and insights help me shape the game into something truly special :3

This update was supposed to be released earlier, but I encountered some unexpected bugs and technical issues that I’m still working hard to fix. My goal is to create a high-quality experience, where players won’t face any frustrating problems and can enjoy smooth, relaxing gameplay. Every step I take is towards making sure your adventure is as immersive and chill as possible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068842/e1d04e8fd1a69de09bc28d345150a9e499388eec.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068842/7d7ec135a3253791b3fd9d839b0eee7727f4e81f.png

Your patience and understanding mean the world to me, and I truly appreciate every message, review, and report you send my way. Thank you for being part of this journey!

notes.title: Furry Adventure Club and the Holy Grail🦁: Demo 0.1D Update!
notes.notes:
https://shared.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3057290/extras/GifTop2.gif

We’re so excited to share version 0.1DB of our lighthearted adventure visual novel, Furry Adventure Club and the Holy Grail🦁! This update is a big step forward as we work hard to get everything ready for the full release. Your support and feedback mean the world to us, and we’re thrilled to have you with us on this journey!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3057290/

Step into the paws of Indica Macjones as she takes her next big leap towards uncovering the legendary Holy Grail! With this update, we’ve polished the gameplay, refreshed the interface, and worked hard to make every moment feel special. Along the way, you’ll explore mysterious locations, meet quirky and lovable furry characters, and immerse yourself in a story we’re pouring our hearts into.

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42902513/8870a6ac6f1c420c6e298d8f2366cb26114178be.png

🎮 What’s new in version 0.1DB:

 A refreshed and intuitive interface to enhance your experience.
 Continued development of key story scenes and environments.
 Improved gameplay balance for smoother progression.
 Bug fixes and tweaks based on valuable community feedback.


We deeply appreciate everyone who’s helping us refine the game by reporting bugs and sharing ideas in Discord and other social media platforms. Your support means the world to us and brings us closer to delivering a memorable adventure!

🔔 Don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist and join our furry community! The adventure is just beginning—there's so much more to discover!
